entries: If you wish to pass you must help the real Kazmiar.
若想通过，你们必须去帮助真正的卡齐玛尔。
Ah yes... that name is familair. I am Kazimar's echo.
啊，对……这名字听着熟悉。我是卡齐玛尔的回响。
You cannot pass here, and I cannot leave. I do not think I can ever leave...
你们过不去，我也离不开。我想我永远都离不开了……
Kazimar? What are you doing here?
卡齐玛尔？你在这里做什么？
